# foundry_agent_routing (Resource)

~> **Preview:** requires `enable_preview` to include `"agent_endpoints"`.

Manages routing on an existing agent's stable endpoint, independently of its definition. Configure exactly one `version_selection_rules` block. The provider routes 100% of traffic to its target with a `FixedRatio` rule internally; the rule type and percentages are not configurable. Split or non-100% routing cannot be managed by this resource. Inspect the read-only endpoint metadata on agent resources or data sources for all service-returned rules and percentages. Only one routing resource should manage a given agent. Destroying this resource leaves routing unchanged and removes it from Terraform state; it does not delete the agent or reset traffic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "foundry" {
  account_name   = var.foundry_account_name
  project_name   = var.foundry_project_name
  enable_preview = ["agent_endpoints"]
}

resource "foundry_prompt_agent" "example" {
  name         = "example-prompt-agent"
  model        = "gpt-4.1-mini"
  instructions = "Answer briefly."
}

resource "foundry_agent_routing" "example" {
  agent_name = foundry_prompt_agent.example.name

  version_selection_rules {
    agent_version = foundry_prompt_agent.example.version
  }
}

output "agent_active_version" {
  value = foundry_agent_routing.example.active_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_name` (String) Name of the existing agent. Changing this relinquishes management of the old agent's routing and manages the new agent's routing.

### Optional

- `version_selection_rules` (Block List) Exactly one routing rule is required. Use an explicit version to pin traffic or `@latest` to automatically serve new versions. The provider sends a `FixedRatio` rule at 100% internally; neither the rule type nor the percentage is configurable. Routing updates do not create agent versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--version_selection_rules))

### Read-Only

- `active_version` (String) Version receiving all stable-endpoint traffic. Resolves `@latest` to the latest version number.
- `id` (String) Agent name, used as the routing resource identifier.

<a id="nestedblock--version_selection_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `version_selection_rules`

Required:

- `agent_version` (String) Existing agent version or `@latest`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foundry_agent_routing.example example-prompt-agent
```
